method_intent: Convert a string representation of a number into a corresponding java.lang.Number type.

parameter.name: str
parameter.description: String containing a numeric value or null.

return.description: A Number object representing the value of the input string, or null if the input is null.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a valid integer string to Integer.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string representing a valid integer.
test_scenarios.expected_behavior_constraints: Returns an Integer object representing the value of the input string.
test_scenarios.rationale: Covers the normal behavior of converting a valid integer string.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a valid floating-point string to Float.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string representing a valid floating-point number.
test_scenarios.expected_behavior_constraints: Returns a Float object representing the value of the input string.
test_scenarios.rationale: Covers the normal behavior of converting a valid floating-point string.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a valid hexadecimal string to BigInteger.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string starting with '0x' or '#', followed by valid hexadecimal digits.
test_scenarios.expected_behavior_constraints: Returns a BigInteger object representing the hexadecimal value of the input string.
test_scenarios.rationale: Covers the normal behavior of converting a valid hexadecimal string.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a null input string.
test_scenarios.rationale: Covers the boundary case where the input is null.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of an empty string.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null empty string.
test_scenarios.rationale: Covers the boundary case where the input is an empty string.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a string with leading or trailing spaces.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string with leading or trailing spaces.
test_scenarios.rationale: Tests the behavior with leading/trailing spaces which is not explicitly documented.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a valid octal string.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string representing a valid octal number (starts with '0').
test_scenarios.expected_behavior_constraints: Returns an Integer, Long, or BigDecimal object depending on the value of the octal string.
test_scenarios.rationale: Covers the edge case of interpreting octal values.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a very large number string that exceeds Long range.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string representing a number larger than Long.MAX_VALUE.
test_scenarios.expected_behavior_constraints: Returns a BigInteger object representing the value of the input string.
test_scenarios.rationale: Covers the edge case of handling very large numbers.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a non-null string containing invalid numeric characters.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string containing characters that are not valid numeric characters.
test_scenarios.rationale: Addresses the missing coverage for invalid numeric strings as per reviewer feedback.

test_scenarios.description: Test conversion of a string consisting solely of whitespace characters.
test_scenarios.input_constraints: Input is a non-null string that contains only whitespace characters.
test_scenarios.rationale: Addresses the missing coverage for strings with only whitespace as per reviewer feedback.
